title: The teacher born in George Washington's time remembers a Native American friend
place_text: Range Two, Indian Springs Valley, Nevada

tellings.quote: remember the teacher in 1965 who had been born when George Washington was born

plain: In 1965, on a desert firing area called Range Two in Indian Springs Valley, Nevada, a pale alien being known as the Teacher is said to have spoken of a Native American friend from long ago, the Teacher having been "born when George Washington was born." Charles Hall, a man who says he spent three years among tall white aliens in the Nevada desert, tells this himself, and if true it would mean these beings live for centuries and have known people on Earth for that long.
